domain-forge

/domain-forge

Turn a textual project idea into a VISUAL, language-agnostic software DOMAIN MODEL rendered as a single self-contained HTML file …

prose→<stem>.domain.html

dataset-forge

/dataset-forge

Geometric, qualitative, neurosymbolic analysis of a tabular dataset: its effective and intrinsic DIMENSIONS, its BASIS (the minimal set of mutually non-derivable features, every other column expressed as a derivation rule), the residual DEPENDENCIES among basis members, and the FEATURE/LABEL partitions they imply, modeled as a …

dataset→<stem>.domain.html with geometry layer, memory § Dataset stances

read the page

data-lens

/data-lens

Traditional, best-practice data analysis of a tabular dataset on top of its /dataset-forge model: data quality and missingness mechanisms, distributions and outliers, residual relations, statistical inference with assumption checks and effect sizes, segments, feature importance and leakage probes on the chosen partition …

dataset model (+ dataset)→<stem>.analysis.html with analysis layer; memory § Analysis stances

dataset-shaper

/dataset-shaper

Materialize decisions an analysis already took: from a /dataset-forge model (its geometry layer — typing, basis, cycle orientation, partition and leakage set) and, when present, the /data-lens analysis layer (findings with transformation candidates), compile a declarative, provenance-traced RECIPE of transformations …

model with geometry (+ analysis)→<stem>.shaped.html with shape layer; shaped/ dataset + recipe.json + manifest.json + lineage.json + reproduce_*.py; memory § Shaping stances

inferred-questions

/inferred-questions

Surface latent modeling questions in a domain-forge HTML model — gaps in DMN coverage, edges of OWL restrictions, SWRL antecedents that never bind, multi-typing under disjointness, rationale that names an external system without defining its failure mode.

any model→<stem>.questions.html

model-chat

/model-chat

Hold an engine-grounded conversation with a domain-forge HTML model. Every answer is produced by RUNNING the model's own engines …

any model→<stem>.chat.html

blueprint

/blueprint

First-architecture proposal pass for a greenfield project — ingest a spec-analysis HTML or a domain-forge model, derive a proposed architectural style and world model plus ranked design findings, every claim traced to the spec or stamped as a designer's choice.

prose spec or model (software or dataset)→blueprint-runs/<ts>/{blueprint.md, findings.json, blueprint.html}
